dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D reduction in width from the mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle bilateral protrusions at the mid-body; otherwise smooth and symmetrical lateral margins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey shading along the lateral flanks and cranial region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradient between pigmented and depigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark point at the blowhole; several faint, white linear marks on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear white markings on the posterior dorsal plane, consistent with healed rake marks.
